request: a snug TPU sleeve for my Anker Power Bank (10000mAh, 22.5W)

body_sources.corner_r: no radius published on https://service.anker.com/product-description/a08J1000000YcHgIAK/anker-power-bank-10000mah-225w; 0 is the enclosing box

why: Lying flat, display up (+z), ports end at +y: Anker publishes the size and 'Ports: 1 USB-C port,1 USB-A port' but no positions; its A1388 user guide (https://salesforce-knowledge-download.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/000019000/en_US/000019000.pdf, pages 1 to 3 figures) shows the button and display on the front face and both ports on one short end, so those two faces stay open and the TPU sleeve grips the rest.
